editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the permissions table, the role-to-action table and the "only existing account members can be invited" caveat. Nothing here would mislead a learner. Entry [50] breaks the pattern set by the parallel steps [44] and [47]. It leaves the UI labels in English ("Next", "Add", "Assign"), where the earlier steps use "Avanti", "Aggiungi", "Assegna". It also renders "Platform access" as "accesso a Platform", which reads as the product IBM Quantum Platform and not the field "Accesso alla piattaforma" used everywhere else. editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The if/switch/while conditions, the 100% outcomes, the odd count of X gates and the GHZ parity steps all match the English. There are three terminology slips. "matrix product states" is rendered "stati a matrice di prodotto" (which means "product-matrix states") instead of the established "stati prodotto di matrici" (MPS). "shallow circuits" becomes the calque "circuiti superficiali" instead of "circuiti poco profondi / a bassa profondità". editor_note: I found no semantic drift. editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The workflow steps, the Executor description and the NoiseLearnerV3 contrast with NoiseLearner (Pauli-Lindblad protocol for gates, TREX for measurements) all match the source, and the "tu" register holds. The main nit is "unique layers" rendered as "strati unici" in [10] and [29]. In Italian "unici" tends to read as "the only/single layers", not "distinct layers", so "strati distinti" would be clearer. There are also a few stiff calques: "tranne che con diversi valori dei parametri assegnati" in [22] and "trasparente ma performante" in [27].

editor_note: The meaning is accurate throughout. Nothing would mislead a learner: the shot-count caveat in [27] ("Gli shot **non** vengono divisi"), the single-randomization caveat in [33] and the shape table in [47] all match the English. A native editor would still fix a few spots. [45] reads "dimensioni di dimensione 1", which repeats the same word awkwardly; [42] already uses the better wording "assi di dimensione 1". editor_note: Faithful and natural, with the key caveats intact: "non offre implementazioni di mitigazione degli errori di misura ... pronte all'uso" and "richiede un backend che supporti l'opzione `memory`"; "primitiva backend" is used consistently and the tu register ("Consulta") holds throughout.

The translation is faithful overall. It uses informal "tu" throughout and keeps its terms consistent (transpilato, gate a due qubit, twirling, valore di aspettazione), and no sentence misleads a learner. There are three small slips. In [7], "directed execution model" became "modello di esecuzione diretto": "diretto" means "direct", but the model's name refers to execution guided by directives, so "guidato" is closer. Also in [7], "bound circuits" became "circuiti associati", which is vague. In [19], "possibilmente" is a false friend: in Italian it usually means "preferably", but the English means "optionally", so "eventualmente" is the right word.

examples.source: it's part of the directed execution model
examples.translation: È invece parte del modello di esecuzione diretto
examples.suggested: Fa invece parte del modello di esecuzione guidata (directed execution model)
examples.why: "Diretto" means "direct", but the English "directed" means execution steered by the user's directives. That is the idea the page is teaching.

examples.why: "Circuiti associati" is vague: it does not say that the parameter values have been assigned to the circuits. "Assegnare" is the usual Italian verb for binding parameter values.

examples.why: False friend: in Italian "possibilmente" usually means "preferably", but the English means "optionally". Use "eventualmente".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the caveats about USD conversion, periodic runtime reporting and notification delays, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The billing-pipeline terms are inconsistent. "Billing system" is "sistema di fatturazione" in [38], then "sistema di addebito" in [39], where "sistema di fatturazione" now stands for the invoicing system, and the same sentence goes back to "fatturazione" for billing. This blurs which system is which. Separately, "l'account viene addebitato" in [23] and [24] is a calque of "the account is billed"; natural Italian is "l'utilizzo viene addebitato sull'account".

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally. The informal 'tu' form holds throughout, as in 'Tieni presente' and 'Puoi verificarlo'.

The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the last 40%. Every caveat survives: notes 4 to 9 keep "as of July 2025", "not eligible for execution on hardware" and "potentially at a runtime cost", and the support table is intact. The problems are phrasing. "il segno 'supportato' completo" (entry 10) is a word-for-word calque, "identificatori hardware-qubit" (entry 19) keeps the English compound, and "non saranno evidenti" (entry 24) calques "evident" where "visibili" is natural. examples.why: The heading and [8] use the feminine 'primitive'; this entry switches to the masculine 'primitivi', so the term is inconsistent within one entry.

examples.source: use the [primitive interface](/guides/primitives)
examples.translation: usare l'[interfaccia primitiva](/guides/primitives)
examples.suggested: usare l'[interfaccia delle primitive](/guides/primitives)
examples.why: Using 'primitiva' as an adjective suggests a rudimentary or basic interface, not the interface of the Qiskit primitives.

examples.source: Most notable among these software tools is the open-source Qiskit SDK, and the runtime environment
examples.translation: il più notevole è il Qiskit SDK open source e l'ambiente di runtime
examples.suggested: i più importanti sono il Qiskit SDK open source e l'ambiente di runtime
examples.why: The singular agreement with a two-part subject reads awkwardly, and 'notevole' is a stiff calque of 'notable'.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout, and the terms are consistent: pass manager, staged pass manager and transpiler pass are kept in English, with stage→fase and preset→preimpostato. Nothing here would mislead a learner. There are two small naturalness slips. In [20], "Per dimostrare questo pass manager in azione" is a literal calque of "To demonstrate ... in action". In [17], "personalizzati" is added to "transpiler pass", which is harmless but not in the source.

examples.source: To demonstrate this pass manager in action, test it on a two-qubit circuit
examples.translation: Per dimostrare questo pass manager in azione, testalo su un circuito a due qubit
examples.suggested: Per vedere questo pass manager in azione, provalo su un circuito a due qubit
examples.why: 'dimostrare ... in azione' is a calque; a native writer would say 'vedere in azione' and 'provalo'.

examples.source: creating (staged) pass managers or even transpilation passes
examples.translation: creando (staged) pass manager o persino transpiler pass personalizzati
examples.suggested: creando (staged) pass manager o persino transpiler pass
examples.why: Adds 'personalizzati', which is not in the source. It fits the context and does not mislead, but it is still an addition.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. Every figure, condition and caveat survives: 400 minutes minimum, depth around 30, 30-120 minutes per run, "not a faster general-purpose computer", and "Quantum Credits" not being open to students. The problems are surface-level. There are typos and grammar slips: "sblocando" for "sbloccando" [41], "delineamo" for "delineiamo" [11], and "Stimiamo che ... richiede" should take the subjunctive "richieda" [30]. The reference headings mistranslate "Features" as "Caratteristiche" [114] and "reviews" as "revisioni" [116, 117], where "rassegne" is correct. "utility-scale" is rendered two ways ("su scala utility" in [41], "su scala di utilità" in [46]), and [47] "da cui esplorare" slightly shifts "at which to explore".

examples.source: unlocking utility-scale work for true innovation
examples.translation: sblocando il lavoro su scala utility per una vera innovazione
examples.suggested: sbloccando il lavoro su scala utility per una vera innovazione
examples.why: Spelling error: 'sblocando' should be 'sbloccando'.

examples.source: is often very interdisciplinary, involving researchers ... In the following paragraphs we outline
examples.translation: è spesso molto interdisciplinare, che coinvolge ricercatori ... Nei paragrafi seguenti delineamo
examples.suggested: è spesso molto interdisciplinare e coinvolge ricercatori ... Nei paragrafi seguenti delineiamo
examples.why: 'delineamo' is a misspelled verb form, and the relative clause 'che coinvolge' is a dangling calque of the English participle.

examples.source: We estimate that the minimum access for novel quantum computing research requires 400 minutes
examples.translation: Stimiamo che l'accesso minimo per la ricerca innovativa nel quantum computing richiede 400 minuti
examples.suggested: Stimiamo che l'accesso minimo per la ricerca innovativa nel quantum computing richieda 400 minuti
examples.why: 'Stimare che' takes the subjunctive in standard Italian.

examples.source: *Reputable News / Features*
examples.translation: *Notizie / Caratteristiche affidabili*
examples.suggested: *Notizie e approfondimenti affidabili*
examples.why: 'Features' here means journalistic feature articles, not 'characteristics'.

examples.source: These systems offer utility-scale research
examples.translation: Questi sistemi offrono ricerca su scala di utilità
examples.suggested: Questi sistemi consentono ricerca su scala utility
examples.why: Inconsistent with 'su scala utility' in [41] and the table in [52]. 'scala di utilità' also reads as a literal calque.

editor_note: The Italian is faithful and reads naturally. It keeps the suppression/mitigation/detection/correction distinctions exactly as the English draws them, including the "degli errori che si sono già verificati" nuance and the Pauli twirling caveat "adattamento del rumore (noise tailoring)". Terms are consistent throughout: fault-tolerant, shot, qubit, and "tu" register ("consulta", "aiutarti").

The meaning is faithful all the way through and nothing would mislead a learner. Little-endian ordering, the CNOT control/target roles, measurement collapse and the caveats on superposition and entanglement all come through intact, and terms stay consistent (sovrapposizione, misurazione, osservabili, autostati, vettore di stato). The problems are a few English calques a native editor would rephrase: "misurare nella base X può essere fatto applicando" (passive, [72]), "È lì per garantire" ([15]), "collassano verso" where Italian says "collassano in/su" ([48], [53]-[55], [105]), and "si riferiscono a" for "relate to" ([60], [62]).

examples.source: measuring in the X basis can be done by applying a Hadamard gate
examples.translation: misurare nella base X può essere fatto applicando un gate di Hadamard
examples.suggested: si può misurare nella base X applicando un gate di Hadamard
examples.why: This copies the English passive with an infinitive subject; Italian technical prose would use an impersonal 'si può'.

examples.source: It is there to ensure that the sum of the squares...
examples.translation: È lì per garantire che la somma dei quadrati...
examples.suggested: Serve a garantire che la somma dei quadrati...
examples.why: 'È lì per' is a literal calque of 'it is there to'.

examples.source: Z basis measurement outcomes collapse to |0> or |1>
examples.translation: Gli esiti della misurazione nella base Z collassano verso |0> o |1>
examples.suggested: Una misurazione nella base Z fa collassare lo stato in |0> o |1>
examples.why: In Italian physics writing a state collapses 'in/su' a state, not 'verso'. The same phrasing appears in [48], [54], [55] and [105].

examples.source: How exactly do these relate to the measurement bases?
examples.translation: In che modo esattamente queste si riferiscono alle basi di misurazione?
examples.suggested: In che modo esattamente sono legate alle basi di misurazione?
examples.why: 'Riferirsi a' means 'refer to'. 'Essere legate a' is the natural way to say 'relate to'. The same wording is used in [60].

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, and nothing would mislead a learner. The antiferromagnetic/transverse-field physics, the Sampler vs Estimator split, the "optimization" caveat and the final challenge ("un'energia ancora più bassa") all match the English. Core terms are consistent: Hamiltoniano, stato fondamentale, osservabili, algoritmi variazionali, mitigazione degli errori. A native editor would still smooth a few calques. [32] "Ottimizzare il circuito per essere eseguito" copies an English infinitive. [37] "è dove capiremo" moves a general statement into the future tense. [43] "deve attraversare" is a literal rendering of "goes through". [16] has an awkward chain of genitives in "l'effetto di capovolgimento degli spin del campo magnetico".

examples.source: Optimize the circuit to be run on a specific backend
examples.translation: Ottimizzare il circuito per essere eseguito su un Backend specifico
examples.suggested: Ottimizzare il circuito affinché possa essere eseguito su un backend specifico
examples.why: 'per essere eseguito' copies the English infinitive of purpose. 'affinché' is the idiomatic Italian.

examples.source: the mapping step is where we figure out how to represent a real-world problem
examples.translation: il passo di mappatura è dove capiremo come rappresentare un problema del mondo reale
examples.suggested: il passo di mappatura è quello in cui stabiliamo come rappresentare un problema del mondo reale
examples.why: This is a general statement, but the future tense 'capiremo' reads as if it were announcing an upcoming step. 'è dove' is also a calque.

examples.source: a required preparation step that every quantum circuit goes through
examples.translation: un passo di preparazione obbligatorio che ogni circuito quantistico deve attraversare
examples.suggested: un passo di preparazione obbligatorio a cui ogni circuito quantistico deve essere sottoposto
examples.why: 'attraversare' is a literal rendering of 'go through'. It is unnatural for a processing step.

examples.source: represent the spin-flipping effect of the magnetic field
examples.translation: rappresentano l'effetto di capovolgimento degli spin del campo magnetico
examples.suggested: rappresentano l'effetto del campo magnetico, che capovolge gli spin
examples.why: The chain of genitives is ambiguous, because 'degli spin del campo magnetico' can be read as 'the spins of the magnetic field'.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, including the QPE derivation, the phase-kickback passage and the true/false items. Nothing would mislead a learner. The problems are wording and consistency. [131] "ci dice solo così tanto" is a calque of "only tells us so much". [30] "del qubit 0 attraverso m-1" copies "through" and should be "dei qubit da 0 a m-1". [53] has the typo "un stato", which should be "uno stato". Several terms switch form within the file: "circuit" vs "circuito" ([50]/[49] vs [102]), "computer quantistico" vs "quantum computer" ([8] vs [79]), and "trasformata di Fourier quantistica" vs "trasformata quantistica di Fourier" ([7] vs [115]/[117]). For momentum, [60] uses "momento", where "quantità di moto" or "impulso" is the standard Italian physics term.

examples.source: the final measurement is only probabilistic and only tells us so much
examples.translation: la misurazione finale è solo probabilistica e ci dice solo così tanto
examples.suggested: la misurazione finale è solo probabilistica e fornisce un'informazione limitata
examples.why: Word-for-word calque; the idiom does not work in Italian.

examples.source: represents the state of qubit 0 through $m-1$, from right to left
examples.translation: rappresenta lo stato del qubit 0 attraverso $m-1$, da destra a sinistra
examples.suggested: rappresenta lo stato dei qubit da 0 a $m-1$, da destra a sinistra
examples.why: 'attraverso' is a literal copy of 'through'. It is unclear and does not describe a range the way Italian normally does.

examples.source: We'll start with making a random computational state
examples.translation: Inizieremo creando un stato computazionale casuale
examples.suggested: Inizieremo creando uno stato computazionale casuale
examples.why: Grammar slip: before 's'+consonant the article must be 'uno'.

examples.source: the uncertainty in momentum ($\Delta p$) must be big
examples.translation: l'incertezza nel momento ($\Delta p$) deve essere grande
examples.suggested: l'incertezza sulla quantità di moto ($\Delta p$) deve essere grande
examples.why: Italian physics calls momentum 'quantità di moto' (or 'impulso'). 'Momento' is a calque that suggests moment or torque.

examples.source: from the [Qiskit circuit library]
examples.translation: dalla [libreria di circuit Qiskit]
examples.suggested: dalla [libreria di circuiti di Qiskit]
examples.why: Here the term is half-translated as 'libreria di circuit'. [108] keeps it as 'circuit library', and elsewhere the file uses 'circuito'. The same term appears in three forms.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. The translation is faithful and uses the informal "tu" throughout, and the order-finding reduction, the GCD argument and the M_2 SWAP construction all keep their meaning. A native editor would still change a few things. In [166] and [167], "La ricerca dell'ordine quantistico" wrongly makes "quantistico" describe the order; it should be "ricerca quantistica dell'ordine". QPE appears both as "Quantum Phase Estimation" ([83], [84], [139]) and as "stima della fase quantistica" ([166], [171]), and "fault-tolerant" ([10]) turns into "tolleranza ai guasti" ([160]). One "Check your understanding" heading ([125]) says "Verifica della comprensione", but every other one says "Metti alla prova la tua comprensione". The conclusion also has some calqued wording: "impressionantemente (o intimidatoriamente)" and "brillantezza".

examples.source: Quantum order finding uses quantum phase estimation techniques to determine the period of the function
examples.translation: La ricerca dell'ordine quantistico utilizza tecniche di stima della fase quantistica per determinare il periodo della funzione
examples.suggested: La ricerca quantistica dell'ordine utilizza tecniche di Quantum Phase Estimation per determinare il periodo della funzione
examples.why: "quantistico" wrongly describes "ordine" (a "quantum order") when it is the search that is quantum. The QPE term also differs from the English "Quantum Phase Estimation" used everywhere else in the file.

examples.source: Check your understanding
examples.translation: Verifica della comprensione
examples.suggested: Metti alla prova la tua comprensione
examples.why: Every other occurrence of this repeated heading says "Metti alla prova la tua comprensione", so this one is inconsistent.

examples.source: once a threshold called *fault tolerance* is reached
examples.translation: una volta raggiunta una soglia chiamata *tolleranza ai guasti*
examples.suggested: una volta raggiunta una soglia chiamata *fault tolerance* (tolleranza ai guasti)
examples.why: Entry [10] keeps the English "fault-tolerant". Switching to the Italian term here with no link back could make a learner miss that it is the same concept.

examples.source: a new appreciation of the brilliance of Peter Shor ... impressively (or intimidatingly) complex
examples.translation: una nuova ammirazione per la brillantezza di Peter Shor ... impressionantemente (o intimidatoriamente) complesso
examples.suggested: una nuova ammirazione per la genialità di Peter Shor ... può sembrare di una complessità impressionante (o intimidatoria)
examples.why: The "-mente" adverbs are calqued from English and "brillantezza" is not idiomatic for someone's intellect. An Italian writer would say "genialità".

editor_note: The page is only three entries and none of them changes the meaning: "Moduli" and "Informatica" are correct and natural. The one thing to change is "Meccanica Quantistica" in entry [3], which copies English title case. Italian writes "Meccanica quantistica", with only the first word capitalized, even in headings and link labels.

examples.source: [Quantum Mechanics](/learning/modules/quantum-mechanics)
examples.translation: [Meccanica Quantistica](/learning/modules/quantum-mechanics)
examples.suggested: [Meccanica quantistica](/learning/modules/quantum-mechanics)
examples.why: Italian does not capitalize every word of a title the way English does. Only the first word takes a capital letter here.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The 4/9 vs 1/2 argument, the option 1/option 2 framing and the entanglement caveats all carry over, and gate/qubit/entanglement/misura are used consistently. There are a few grammar slips a native editor would fix: the reflexive "si decada/si decade" appears in the MC questions [178], [183] and [190], and should be "decada/decade". [84] has "ci aspetterebbe" where it should read "ti aspetteresti", and [172] has the ungrammatical "Qualsiasi due sistemi correlati". There are also a couple of wording problems. In [26], "si propaga attraverso lo spazio" suggests a signal travelling through space, which slightly undercuts the non-local point the paragraph is making. The gate definitions in [96], [99] and [102] start with a lowercase "gate", and [66] has the calque "Criticamente".

examples.source: Suppose a spin-0 particle decays into two spin-1/2 particles A and B.
examples.translation: Supponiamo che una particella con spin 0 si decada in due particelle con spin 1/2
examples.suggested: Supponiamo che una particella con spin 0 decada in due particelle con spin 1/2
examples.why: 'Decadere' is not reflexive. The same error appears in [183] ('si decade') and [190].

examples.source: So you would expect that probability to be zero
examples.translation: Quindi ci aspetterebbe che tale probabilità sia zero
examples.suggested: Quindi ti aspetteresti che tale probabilità sia zero
examples.why: This is ungrammatical. It has the wrong clitic and person, and it breaks the informal 'tu' register.

examples.source: T/F Any two correlated systems are quantum mechanically entangled.
examples.translation: V/F Qualsiasi due sistemi correlati sono quantisticamente entangled.
examples.suggested: V/F Due sistemi correlati qualsiasi sono entangled in senso quantistico.
examples.why: 'Qualsiasi' can't come before a numeral like this in Italian. It is a calque of 'any two'.

examples.source: This effect occurs spread out across the space between the positron and electron.
examples.translation: Questo effetto si propaga attraverso lo spazio tra il positrone e l'elettrone.
examples.suggested: Questo effetto si manifesta esteso nello spazio tra il positrone e l'elettrone.
examples.why: 'Si propaga' suggests a signal travelling through space. The source describes a non-local effect spread across that space, which is the opposite idea.

examples.source: Critically, note that $A$ is independent of $\vec{b}$
examples.translation: Criticamente, nota che $A$ è indipendente da $\vec{b}$
examples.suggested: È fondamentale notare che $A$ è indipendente da $\vec{b}$
examples.why: 'Criticamente' is a calque. In Italian it means 'critically' in the sense of judging, not 'crucially'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The Move = reset + SWAP explanation, the entanglement caveat in [20], the qubit-reuse point in [21]/[22] and the 4^4 overhead are all intact, and the page uses "tu" consistently. A few calques remain. "La funzione cut_wires esiste per trasformare" should be "serve a trasformare". "circuito di dimensione intera" should be "circuito completo". "un coefficiente combinato per ogni campione unico" can be misread as "a single sample" and should be "campione distinto". In [46], "valore atteso esatto dal Circuit" should be "del circuito".

examples.source: one combined coefficient is given for each unique sample
examples.translation: viene fornito un coefficiente combinato per ogni campione unico
examples.suggested: viene fornito un coefficiente combinato per ogni campione distinto
examples.why: 'campione unico' reads as 'single/only sample' in Italian; 'unique' here means distinct.

examples.source: the expectation value of the full-sized circuit
examples.translation: il valore atteso del circuito di dimensione intera
examples.suggested: il valore atteso del circuito completo (a grandezza piena)
examples.why: 'di dimensione intera' is a literal calque that a native writer would not use.

examples.source: The `cut_wires` function exists to transform `CutWire`s to `Move` instructions
examples.translation: La funzione `cut_wires` esiste per trasformare le `CutWire` in istruzioni `Move`
examples.suggested: La funzione `cut_wires` serve a trasformare le `CutWire` in istruzioni `Move`
examples.why: 'esiste per' is a calque of the English 'exists to'.

examples.source: the exact expectation value from the original circuit and observable
examples.translation: il valore atteso esatto dal Circuit e dall'osservabile originali
examples.suggested: il valore atteso esatto del circuito e dell'osservabile originali
examples.why: 'dal' follows the English 'from'. Italian uses 'del' here.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The PEC contrast, the non-monotonic caveats in [39]/[40], the top-30-terms explanation in [43] and the noise scale set to 0.0 in [54] all come through faithfully, and nothing would mislead a learner. There are a few polish issues. 'layer' is used everywhere except [54]/[55], where it switches to 'strato di rumore'. Section headings mix infinitives ('Generare', 'Apprendere', 'Propagare') with imperatives ('Trasforma', 'Specifica', 'Campiona', 'Post-processa'). [39] has the calque 'non è garantito come monotono', and [9] keeps English 'coupling' where Italian physics uses 'accoppiamento'.

examples.source: We set each noise layer's scale to `0.0`
examples.translation: Impostiamo la scala di ogni strato di rumore a `0.0`
examples.suggested: Impostiamo la scala di ogni layer di rumore a `0.0`
examples.why: Everywhere else in the file (including 'layer di rumore' in [20]) the term is 'layer'. Switching to 'strato' here and in [55] makes the terminology inconsistent.

examples.source: but this behavior is not guaranteed to be monotonic
examples.translation: ma questo comportamento non è garantito come monotono
examples.suggested: ma non è garantito che questo comportamento sia monotono
examples.why: 'garantito come' copies the English structure word for word. It is not natural Italian.

examples.source: Transform the measurement bases to canonical form
examples.translation: Trasforma le basi di misura in forma canonica
examples.suggested: Trasformare le basi di misura in forma canonica
examples.why: Earlier headings ([6], [25], [34], [36]) use the infinitive, but [45], [48], [57] and [59] switch to the imperative. The heading style should be the same throughout.

examples.source: describes the coupling of nearest-neighbor spins
examples.translation: descrive il coupling degli spin primi vicini
examples.suggested: descrive l'accoppiamento tra spin primi vicini
examples.why: 'accoppiamento' is the standard Italian physics term. Leaving 'coupling' in English is unnecessary.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The forward/backward bound logic, the merge-point note in [83], the SLC bias/overhead trade-off in [108] and the PEC vs PEC+SLC conclusions in [120]-[123] all match the source. What an editor would change is terminology and a few stiff phrases. 'bounds' switches between 'limiti' and the English 'bounds' ([57], [61], [66], [68], [105]). 'antinoise' appears as 'anti-rumore', 'antinoise' and 'rumore inverso' ([18], [43], [111]). 'workflow' alternates with 'flusso di lavoro'. 'osservabile' is feminine in some places and masculine in others ([4] vs [35]/[36]). A device edge is 'arco' in [8]/[52] but 'bordi' in [118]. There is also a typo, 'traspilaremo' ([40]), plus the calques 'Come tale' ([50]) and 'derivare nel tempo' ([103]).

examples.source: First, we will transpile our circuit to ISA instructions
examples.translation: Prima di tutto, traspilaremo il nostro circuito in istruzioni ISA
examples.suggested: Prima di tutto, traspileremo il nostro circuito in istruzioni ISA
examples.why: Misspelled future tense: the verb 'traspilare' conjugates as 'traspileremo'.

examples.source: filter based on single-qubit nodes or neighboring spectator edges
examples.translation: filtrare in base a nodi a singolo qubit o a bordi spettatori vicini
examples.suggested: filtrare in base a nodi a singolo qubit o ad archi spettatori vicini
examples.why: A graph or coupling-map edge is 'arco', which the file itself uses in [8] and [52]. 'bordi' means a physical border.

examples.source: where, in the case of PEC, antinoise should be injected into the circuit
examples.translation: dove, nel caso del PEC, l'antinoise deve essere iniettato nel circuito
examples.suggested: dove, nel caso della PEC, l'anti-rumore deve essere iniettato nel circuito
examples.why: The file renders 'antinoise' three ways: anti-rumore [18], antinoise [43] and rumore inverso [111]. It should use one form.

examples.source: As such, it might be prudent to use parallelized execution
examples.translation: Come tale, potrebbe essere opportuno utilizzare l'esecuzione parallelizzata
examples.suggested: Pertanto, potrebbe essere opportuno ricorrere all'esecuzione parallela
examples.why: 'Come tale' is a word-for-word calque of 'As such' and is not natural Italian as a connective.

examples.source: Details of your noise model are at risk of drifting over time.
examples.translation: I dettagli del tuo modello di rumore rischiano di derivare nel tempo.
examples.suggested: I dettagli del tuo modello di rumore possono subire una deriva nel tempo.
examples.why: A reader will take 'derivare' in its usual sense of 'derive/originate'. The standard technical phrase for drift is 'subire una deriva'.

examples.source: We next tighten the bounds by using the `tighten_with_speed_limit` function
examples.translation: Successivamente restringiamo i bounds utilizzando la funzione
examples.suggested: Successivamente restringiamo i limiti utilizzando la funzione
examples.why: Most of the file uses 'limiti', but [57], [61], [66], [68] and [105] switch to the English 'bounds'. Sometimes both appear in the same sentence.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The numbers, the feasibility conditions, the Iskay dictionary example and the preprocessing/postprocessing level lists all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The address form switches between "tu" (assicurati, Definisci, Scegli) and plural "voi" (Dovrete, importate, specificate, Considerate, Sperimentate). "Gate" is rendered as "porte" in [23] but as "gate" everywhere else, "post-processing" alternates with "post-elaborazione", and step headings switch from "Passaggio 1" to "Passo 2/3/4". Smaller slips: [113] has the truncated "controdiabatic", [147] says "profondità di circuito più superficiali", and [145] renders "fine-tuning capabilities" as the vaguer "capacità di ottimizzazione".

examples.source: implementing the counterdiabatic evolution protocol
examples.translation: che implementa il protocollo di evoluzione controdiabatic
examples.suggested: che implementa il protocollo di evoluzione controdiabatica
examples.why: Truncated adjective; the rest of the file correctly uses 'controdiabatico/i'.

examples.source: remarkable gate reduction ... 10 times fewer entangling gates
examples.translation: riduzione delle porte ... 10 volte meno porte di entanglement
examples.suggested: riduzione dei gate ... 10 volte meno gate di entanglement
examples.why: Everywhere else the file keeps 'gate' (e.g. [109], [129], [147]); 'porte' only appears here.

examples.source: You will also need to get access to
examples.translation: Dovrete anche ottenere l'accesso
examples.suggested: Dovrai anche ottenere l'accesso
examples.why: Plural 'voi' mixed with the 'tu' used elsewhere (e.g. [27] 'assicurati', [37] 'Definisci'); also in [35], [79], [152], [180], [195].

examples.source: Higher preprocessing levels achieve shallower circuit depths
examples.translation: ottengono profondità di circuito più superficiali
examples.suggested: producono circuiti meno profondi
examples.why: 'Profondità ... superficiali' is a contradictory calque; the file itself uses 'circuiti meno profondi' elsewhere.

examples.source: Iskay provides fine-tuning capabilities through optional parameters
examples.translation: Iskay fornisce capacità di ottimizzazione attraverso parametri opzionali
examples.suggested: Iskay consente una regolazione fine tramite parametri opzionali
examples.why: 'Ottimizzazione' is ambiguous in an optimization tutorial and loses the sense of 'fine-tuning'.

examples.source: Step 2: Optimize problem for quantum hardware execution
examples.translation: Passo 2: ...
examples.suggested: Passaggio 2: ... (matching [38] 'Passaggio 1')
examples.why: Step headings are rendered inconsistently: 'Passaggio 1' vs 'Passo 2/3/4'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The bit-ordering note [50], the four Qiskit Patterns steps, the Sampler/Estimator distinction and the shots explanation [67] all match the English, and nothing would mislead a learner. What remains is a few calques a native editor would fix. "La tua carta di credito non verrà addebitata" [5] is unidiomatic, since in Italian an amount is charged to a card, not the card itself. "Per favore crea" [5] copies English "Please". "Per corrispondere all'ISA" [61] is a literal rendering of "to match". Heading mood is also inconsistent: some headings use the infinitive ("Installare Qiskit" [7], "Effettuare le importazioni" [14]) and others the imperative ("Configura" [16], "Crea ed esegui" [28], "Esegui" [69]). The IT text of entries [55]-[56] could not be read in full because base64 image data is embedded in them.

examples.source: Your credit card is not charged in this process or at random after registering.
examples.translation: La tua carta di credito non verrà addebitata durante questo processo né in modo casuale dopo la registrazione.
examples.suggested: Non ti verrà addebitato nulla sulla carta di credito durante questa procedura, né in seguito senza preavviso.
examples.why: 'Addebitare la carta' is a calque. Idiomatic Italian charges an amount to the card, and 'in modo casuale' reads stiffly.

examples.source: transforms the circuit and observables to match that backend's ISA
examples.translation: trasforma il circuito e le osservabili per corrispondere all'ISA di quel Backend
examples.suggested: trasforma il circuito e le osservabili per adattarli all'ISA di quel backend
examples.why: 'Per corrispondere a' is a literal rendering of 'to match'. As written, the subject of the purpose clause reads as the code, not the circuit.

examples.source: Install Qiskit
examples.translation: Installare Qiskit
examples.suggested: Installa Qiskit
examples.why: Some headings use the infinitive ([7], [14]) while most use the imperative ([16], [28], [35], [69]). The file should pick one.

examples.source: executes the selection of circuits, observables, and parameters (if applicable)
examples.translation: esegue la selezione di Circuit, osservabili e parametri (se applicabili)
examples.suggested: esegue l'insieme di circuiti, osservabili ed eventuali parametri selezionati
examples.why: 'Esegue la selezione di' is a word-for-word calque and is awkward in Italian.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the T1 decay, GHZ noise and teleportation/criteria 6-7 passages, and nothing would mislead a learner. A native editor would still fix some small slips. Entry [36] mixes moods ("Se hai bisogno… applicheresti"). Entry [12] uses the anglicism "impatta sui calcoli". Entry [80] has the agreement error "l'effetto del T₁, T₂ finiti". Entry [49] calques "is known to be" as "è noto per essere". "Measurement" also switches between "misura" ([10], [34]) and "misurazione" (elsewhere), and [35] drops the "cools the qubit down" image.

examples.source: If you needed a different starting state, you’d apply gates at the beginning
examples.translation: Se hai bisogno di uno stato iniziale diverso, applicheresti dei gate all'inizio
examples.suggested: Se ti servisse uno stato iniziale diverso, applicheresti dei gate all'inizio
examples.why: The hypothetical mixes the indicative and the conditional. It needs the imperfect subjunctive with the conditional.

examples.source: seeing the effect of finite T₁, T₂ on algorithm fidelity
examples.translation: osservare l'effetto del T₁, T₂ finiti sulla fedeltà degli algoritmi
examples.suggested: osservare l'effetto di T₁ e T₂ finiti sulla fedeltà degli algoritmi
examples.why: The singular article "del" doesn't agree with the plural "finiti", so the phrase reads as ungrammatical.

examples.source: how finite coherence (T₁, T₂) impacts computations
examples.translation: come la coerenza finita (T₁, T₂) impatta sui calcoli
examples.suggested: come la coerenza finita (T₁, T₂) influisce sui calcoli
examples.why: "Impattare su" is an anglicism. The file already uses "influisce" elsewhere ([14], [39]).

examples.source: This set is known to be universal for quantum computing
examples.translation: Questo set è noto per essere universale per il calcolo quantistico
examples.suggested: È noto che questo set è universale per il calcolo quantistico
examples.why: "È noto per essere" is a calque of the English "is known to be" structure.

examples.source: The Bell state measurement should give roughly 50% `00`
examples.translation: La misura dello stato di Bell dovrebbe dare circa il 50% `00`
examples.suggested: La misurazione dello stato di Bell dovrebbe dare circa il 50% `00`
examples.why: "Measurement" is rendered as "misura" in [10] and [34] but as "misurazione" everywhere else, including the Criterion 5 heading. Both are correct, but the file should use one of them.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The T₁/T₂ definitions, the GHZ expectations, the |10⟩ qubit ordering, the Toffoli decomposition and the mapping of criteria 6 and 7 all match the English, so nothing would mislead a learner. What a native editor would still change: the "Goal of Demo" label is rendered two ways ("Obiettivo della Dimostrazione" in [15]/[27], "Obiettivo della Demo" from [37] on). There are also a few calques. [8] has no verb ("la coerenza del qubit molto più lunga del..."). [33] renders "dumps any existing state" as "scarica qualsiasi stato esistente" and drops the "cools down" image. [40] repeats "Esegui il transpiling ... ed eseguili". [18] switches tense in mid-sentence ("useremo ... e rieseguiamo").

examples.source: (qubit coherence much longer than gate operation time)
examples.translation: (la coerenza del qubit molto più lunga del tempo di operazione del gate)
examples.suggested: (tempo di coerenza del qubit molto più lungo della durata di un gate)
examples.why: The parenthetical has no verb and reads as a word-for-word calque. It also compares 'coerenza' with a time, which does not quite work.

examples.source: **Goal of Demo:**
examples.translation: **Obiettivo della Demo:**
examples.suggested: **Obiettivo della dimostrazione:** (same as [15] and [27])
examples.why: This recurring section label is rendered two ways in the file: 'Dimostrazione' in [15]/[27] and 'Demo' in [37]/[43]/[55].

examples.source: it dumps any existing state and cools the qubit down to ground state
examples.translation: scarica qualsiasi stato esistente e riporta il qubit allo stato fondamentale
examples.suggested: elimina qualsiasi stato preesistente e raffredda il qubit riportandolo allo stato fondamentale
examples.why: 'Scarica' is a literal rendering of 'dumps' and is odd in Italian. The physical image of cooling the qubit is lost.

examples.source: Transpile the circuits for this backend and execute them.
examples.translation: Esegui il transpiling dei Circuit per questo backend ed eseguili.
examples.suggested: Transpila i circuiti per questo backend ed eseguili.
examples.why: 'Esegui ... ed eseguili' repeats the same verb, which reads clumsily.

examples.source: we'll use a fake backend ... and re-run the GHZ circuits through that
examples.translation: useremo un fake backend ... e rieseguiamo i circuiti GHZ attraverso di esso
examples.suggested: useremo un fake backend ... e rieseguiremo i circuiti GHZ con esso
examples.why: The sentence switches from future to present tense halfway through.
